children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Evolve declarative APIs and reconciliation safely, including generated schemas, RBAC, chart copies, and envtest.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Helm does not upgrade existing CRDs automatically; keep generated chart CRDs and upgrade instructions in sync. The standalone profile (operator.enabled=false) omits bundled CRDs (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Reconcile idempotently from spec to owned resources and actionable, current status.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Use owner references and finalizers deliberately.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Never treat controller-owned status as desired input.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Report observedGeneration, phase, conditions, reason, and message.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Go types and Kubebuilder markers are source; generated code, schemas, RBAC, and chart copies are reviewed artifacts.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Edit operator/api/v1alpha1 types and compatibility-conscious markers.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Run make generate for deepcopy and make manifests for CRDs/RBAC.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Use unit tests for helpers, envtest for API/controller behavior, and kind e2e for real scheduling, networking, storage, images, and Jobs.

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
